svg.title: One GRPO step on one GPU
svg.desc: One GRPO step of Qwen3-0.6B on one DGX Spark GB10, drawn as machines on one bench. GSM8K prompts, 32 a step, go to the SGLang engine, which writes 256 answers. A math reward scores each answer 1 or 0, and the FSDP trainer learns from the scores. The weight update takes the new weights back to the engine. Below, the same GB10 memory is drawn as one board that the engine and the trainer take in turns, to scale: the engine for 47.5 s, the trainer for 23.4 s of log probabilities and 77.0 s of GRPO update, and the weight update for 0.64 s, in a median step of 152.6 s. Medians of 48 steps of a run made before we added the heat guard.
svg.text: ONE GRPO STEP · QWEN3-0.6B ON ONE DGX SPARK GB10
THE SAME GB10 MEMORY, TAKEN IN TURNS · ONE STEP TO SCALE
152.6 s a step, median of 48 steps
GB10 · 128 GB shared by engine and trainer

g.text: the trainer wakes in 0.87 s, then computes log probabilities
the trainer takes the GRPO update, Adam, one step
the weight update reaches the engine, the trainer offloads in 0.76 s

svg.text: Medians from the run made before the heat guard, so no pause could occur.
